people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.
translations.bsb: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
translations.kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
translations.asv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercury, because he was the chief speaker.
